findings.title: Unprotected trigger branches can feed executable code to personal development runners
findings.remediation: Restrict who can push; gate new code at owner-reviewed immutable SHA; keep runner offline when not testing

findings.title: Actual staging H-01–H-11 and Smoke A/B remain 0/11 and 0/2
findings.limitations: Source-only 979 CI cases cannot substitute for installed host
findings.remediation: Run authentic staging H first, unchanged Smoke A/B last per owner order

findings.title: Older integration release-gates JSON conflicts with latest owner solo-developer policy/current model counts
findings.remediation: Do not treat historical JSON as current owner gate; annotate/reconcile when a bounded docs edit is authorized

findings.title: Nine PrismCell identities are logical; one connected admin and 29 unprotected branches do not establish per-role write isolation
findings.limitations: No forged live foreign-branch write observed
findings.remediation: Require trustworthy role provenance before any automated privileged use; remain supervised otherwise

findings.title: Model evaluation stopped with 209/1080 completed/graded, 871 remaining and terminal candidate quota checkpoint
findings.limitations: Partial self-reviewed AI-assisted grades not independent certification; 3 accuracy exclusions; 54 visible holdouts
findings.remediation: Keep frozen receipts; resolve terminal checkpoint without overwriting evidence, then finish genuine trials and owner self-review

findings.title: PrismCell real clean install in a different repository G1–G5 NOT_RUN; draft PR #20 holds documentation correction
findings.limitations: Offline 52-file fixture is not second-repository installation
findings.remediation: Run only when owner designates a safe separate test repo; no production copies or paid services

findings.title: Blue workcell carries older integration product/source/workflows; comparisons show major divergence
findings.limitations: No unauthorized merge seen; preserving legacy files is intentional
findings.remediation: Allowlist selective evidence/patch promotion; prohibit broad workcell merges

findings.title: Evaluation workflow uses a source-controlled commit-message prefix and environment constant to gate costly model-run workflow
findings.limitations: These strings are not cryptographic owner consent; GitHub writer permissions remain prerequisite
findings.remediation: Prefer separately approved trusted SHA/manual gate before spending quota or touching owner runner

findings.title: Optional idea/feature library generator writes derived INDEX.md without destination-symlink rejection
findings.limitations: Requires operator running optional utility in filesystem with unsafe symlink; no exploit run
findings.remediation: Reject symlink index targets and verify path confinement before writing; keep optional utility separate from product runtime

findings.title: PrismCell universal core declares project reuse but requires github-issues-manual, github.com URLs and GitHub receipts
findings.limitations: Reusable across GitHub projects; not host/provider-neutral transport today
findings.remediation: Describe precisely as GitHub-manual-Issues core or implement a separate validated transport adapter if explicitly approved

findings.title: main only contains minimal README, while v0.0.1 release and v0.0.2 integration are elsewhere
findings.limitations: Intentional release restraint, not product failure or missing tests
findings.remediation: Provide non-promotional source pointers/read-only status in main only if separately approved

findings.title: Green Action result on bounded full-evaluation resume reflects graceful quota stop, not full matrix pass; newer eval HEAD distinct from previous dual-OS dev regression SHA
findings.limitations: Terminal read-only checkpoint audit exactly reports matrix_complete=false
findings.remediation: Consume exact job output, commit and evidence classifications; never translate job success to released quality

findings.title: PrismCell cloud-control prototype's dispatch endpoint always denies and durable authorization/leases are not deployed
findings.limitations: Correct fail-closed staging posture, not a breach
findings.remediation: Do not call it an active autonomous service or enable it without actual scoped credentials and durable CAS
